harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, CentOS Stream 10) since none existed previously: installed mariadb-server/mariadb-server-galera/galera, configured wsrep, opened firewalld galera+mysql services, generated an SST auth password and app credentials directly on node1 (transferred to node2/node3 over the cluster SSH keypair, never printed to the transcript), and worked around an SELinux mysqld_t self-connectto AVC denial (a known gap in the EL10 policy for mariabackup SST) by compiling and loading a minimal custom policy module on all three nodes rather than disabling enforcement. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3 via mariabackup SST, verified 3/3 Synced. Created appdb.orders with an initial committed row, then executed the required maintenance-window drill: inserted a second committed row, took a full baseline, stopped mariadb on node2, node3, then node1 last (preserving safe_to_bootstrap on node1), confirmed the cluster fully down, then bootstrapped node1 and rejoined node2/node3 — both rows present on all three nodes with cluster_size=3/Synced. Finally ran the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured each node's boot_id and healthy service/data state, rebooted node2, node3, and node1 one at a time (never overlapping), polled until each came back, proved boot_id changed each time, and verified mariadb auto-started, rejoined with full quorum (cluster_size=3, Synced), and both data rows intact after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera on node1/node2/node3
Configured /etc/hosts and /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf with wsrep cluster settings on all nodes
Opened firewalld galera+mysql services on all nodes
Set up cluster SSH keypair for inter-node root access
Generated SST auth password and app password on node1 and distributed via scp (never printed)
Diagnosed and fixed an SELinux AVC denial (mysqld_t self connectto unix_stream_socket) by building and loading a custom .pp policy module on all 3 nodes
Bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster, created sstuser and appdb.orders with app user, joined node2 and node3 via SST
Enabled mariadb systemd service on all nodes
Inserted a second committed row, captured pre-shutdown baseline on all 3 nodes
Stopped mariadb on node2, node3, then node1 (full cluster down for maintenance window)
Verified safe_to_bootstrap:1 in node1 grastate.dat and confirmed all 3 nodes inactive
Restarted cluster: galera_new_cluster on node1, started mariadb on node2 and node3, verified 3/3 Synced with both committed rows present
Captured per-node boot_id baseline
Rebooted node2, node3, node1 sequentially (one at a time), polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified mariadb active with cluster_size=3/Synced and data intact after each

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-node Galera cluster established with application data (appdb.orders)
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, appdb.orders created with baseline row, node2 and node3 joined via SST reaching cluster_size=3/Synced with data replicated

evidence.requirement: Fixed root cause blocking SST (SELinux AVC denial) instead of disabling security
evidence.summary: Identified mysqld_t self connectto denial via kernel audit log, compiled and loaded a minimal custom SELinux module on all 3 nodes allowing exactly that operation

evidence.requirement: Credentials generated on managed nodes, not exposed in tool commands/report
evidence.summary: SST and app passwords generated via openssl directly on node1, written to files, and injected into configs/SQL via $(cat ...) shell substitution, never echoed to stdout

evidence.requirement: Pre-maintenance baseline: all 3 nodes healthy and holding both committed rows
evidence.summary: Inserted second row on node2; node1 and node3 both show cluster_size=3, Synced, and both rows present

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node2, node3, then node1 last (safe_to_bootstrap:1 confirmed in grastate.dat); all 3 nodes confirmed inactive

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with every committed write present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped with both rows present; node2 and node3 restarted and rejoined; all 3 nodes independently confirm cluster_size=3, Synced, and both committed rows intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=21de1f79...; reboot acked, node became unreachable, then returned with boot_id=da42ee5c... (changed); mariadb active with cluster_size=3/Synced and both rows present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=be303eb3...; reboot acked, node unreachable, then returned with boot_id=4ea03d68... (changed); mariadb active with cluster_size=3/Synced and both rows present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (last node, quorum preserved throughout since node2/node3 already healthy)
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=8f258838...; reboot acked, node unreachable, then returned with boot_id=848ef267... (changed); mariadb active with cluster_size=3/Synced; final cross-check on all 3 nodes confirms cluster_size=3, Synced, and both committed rows present everywhere
